title: Keep a child's planning edit admissible when its parent's reparent is refused
outcome: A refused unsupported parent move keeps current roots for existing descendants, allowing their independent planning edits to apply.
acceptance: A folder that requests an unsupported reparent of existing T under another root and only a title edit of existing child C refuses T while applying C's title; C retains its current root
